oracles.precondition: Sample or populated workspace with review queue.
oracles.goal: Inspect why a stock merits attention, then deliberately continue or dismiss.
oracles.supportedRealInput: Open the first review row; inspect Why now, risk, and freshness; optionally choose Record review.
oracles.visibleOutcome: Review panel labels evidence/freshness and offers explicit next action.
oracles.semanticOutcome: Opening detail is read-only; a review decision occurs only after deliberate save.
oracles.correctRecordOrObjectEffect: Only selected review/decision object may change after acknowledgement.
oracles.prohibitedEffects: No order, provider delivery, or outcome claim.
oracles.recoveryAndRepeatPath: Done/Escape returns to same row; open it again.
oracles.nextLegitimateAction: Record a review or continue another item.
oracles.evidence: 200% screenshot and r11 Today task; action geometry below initial viewport at stress profiles.

oracles.precondition: Sample workspace and a selected stock.
oracles.goal: Inspect a stock and a metric, then return to exact stock context.
oracles.supportedRealInput: Search/select AAPL; activate Evidence detail; Escape/Done.
oracles.visibleOutcome: Stock detail and metric sheet show source/freshness/missing data and selected ticker.
oracles.semanticOutcome: Read-only drilldown; exact same stock remains selected on close.
oracles.prohibitedEffects: No live price or financial truth inferred from mock data.
oracles.recoveryAndRepeatPath: Close detail and reopen same metric.
oracles.nextLegitimateAction: Inspect an evidence-backed review or register an Eye.
oracles.evidence: CHG-172/184 E2E task path; 200% sequence stopped after a locator detached during AAPL option selection; no product-fault inference from harness retry.

oracles.precondition: Sample workspace with recipe and scanner evidence.
oracles.goal: Review recipe purpose, supported logic, and scanner evidence.
oracles.visibleOutcome: Version, purpose, source coverage, status, and limitations are visible.
oracles.semanticOutcome: Read-only until user saves a recipe version or review log.
oracles.correctRecordOrObjectEffect: Only explicit recipe version or scanner review log after save.
oracles.prohibitedEffects: No opportunity certainty from missing/stale/partial evidence; no trading effect.
oracles.recoveryAndRepeatPath: Close detail/help, reopen row, retry with explicit reason.
oracles.nextLegitimateAction: Inspect a supported rule or record a deliberate review.
oracles.evidence: Existing CHG-172/184/199 tests; current mobile 360 open-set action bottom y866 is outside initial 800px viewport.

oracles.goal: Open a flow, inspect an Eye, optionally mark reviewed or edit/journal.

oracles.visibleOutcome: Selected stock, recipe, status, thesis and next action stay paired.
oracles.semanticOutcome: Read-only open; mark reviewed/effect occurs on explicit action acknowledgement.
oracles.correctRecordOrObjectEffect: Only selected Eye review timestamp/state or explicitly saved edit/journal.
oracles.prohibitedEffects: No provider action, trading execution, or fabricated review result.
oracles.nextLegitimateAction: Review another Eye or record a journal entry.
oracles.evidence: CHG-184 deep flows; scroll stress records nav outside viewport while task controls remain scroll reachable.

oracles.goal: Inspect a decision, amend it, and review history.
oracles.supportedRealInput: Open decision evidence; choose Edit; change text; Save; open previous versions.
oracles.visibleOutcome: Detail shows original context, updated record and amendment history.
oracles.semanticOutcome: Only saved user decision text/history changes after repository acknowledgement.
oracles.correctRecordOrObjectEffect: No inference of investment return or execution.
oracles.prohibitedEffects: Cancel/Escape; reopen saved record and compare history.
oracles.status: CHG-199 authoring tests on exact same source tree and CHG-172 task coverage.

oracles.goal: Validate, create, edit, and cancel an Eye.

oracles.semanticOutcome: Only local preference changes after repository acknowledgement; worker/provider delivery remains separate.
oracles.correctRecordOrObjectEffect: No claim of send cancellation or delivery receipt unless worker evidence says so.
oracles.prohibitedEffects: Cancel preserves setting; retry after failure; confirm success closes only after local save.
oracles.recoveryAndRepeatPath: Review local preference status and external handoff status separately.

oracles.precondition: Async scanner/market refresh source path exists; controlled workspace fixture required.

oracles.supportedRealInput: Defer result, save newer operation, switch A→B→A, release stale result.
oracles.visibleOutcome: Current-object identity and pending/saved/error state remain correct.
oracles.semanticOutcome: Only result owned by current workspace generation/operation may publish.
oracles.correctRecordOrObjectEffect: No stale scan/snapshot overwrite in a different current context.
oracles.recoveryAndRepeatPath: Continue only after fresh current-context evidence.
